header.title: Automatisation DevOps
header.subtitle: Accelerate Delivery with DevOps Automation
header.description: Streamline your software delivery with modern DevOps practices. From CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes orchestration to infrastructure as code and observability, we help startups and enterprises ship faster, safer, and more reliably.

overview.title: Service Overview
overview.content: Our DevOps Automation service transforms how your team builds, tests, and deploys software. We implement battle-tested CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code using Terraform and Pulumi, comprehensive monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana, and GitOps workflows that bring consistency and auditability to your deployments. Whether you are a startup looking to establish DevOps best practices or an enterprise modernising legacy infrastructure, we deliver automation that reduces toil and accelerates your release cadence.

features.title: CI/CD Pipeline Setup
features.description: Design and implementation of robust continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or ArgoCD.

features.title: Container Orchestration
features.description: Kubernetes cluster setup, configuration, and management including Helm charts, service mesh, and auto-scaling for production workloads.

features.title: Infrastructure as Code
features.description: Automated infrastructure provisioning and management using Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation across multi-cloud environments.

features.title: Automated Testing
features.description: Integration of automated testing into your pipeline including unit tests, integration tests, security scanning, and performance testing.

features.title: Deployment Automation
features.description: Zero-downtime deployment strategies including blue-green, canary, and rolling deployments with automated rollback capabilities.

features.title: Observability Stack
features.description: Full observability implementation with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and alerting to provide deep visibility into application and infrastructure health.

pricing.title: Tarifs
pricing.description: Engagements starting from £3,000. Scaled to your infrastructure complexity.

steps.title: Infrastructure Audit
steps.description: We review your existing infrastructure, deployment processes, and toolchain to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

steps.title: Architecture Design
steps.description: We design a modern DevOps architecture tailored to your team size, technology stack, and scalability requirements.

steps.title: Pipeline Implementation
steps.description: We build and configure CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and infrastructure as code from the ground up.

steps.title: Monitoring & Observability
steps.description: We deploy a comprehensive observability stack with dashboards, alerts, and logging to ensure full visibility.

steps.title: Training & Handover
steps.description: We train your team on the new tools and workflows, provide runbooks, and offer ongoing support during the transition.

cta.title: Ready to Get Started?
cta.description: Automate your software delivery pipeline. Book a consultation to discuss your DevOps transformation.
